title: Forensic Failure Mode Audit
summary_statement: PHASE 20 STEP 12 — FORENSIC FAILURE ANALYSIS COMPLETE
acceptance_threshold_note: NO HISTORICAL ACCEPTANCE THRESHOLD RECOVERED FOR STEP 12

template_collapse.description: 100.0% of top generations concentrate in 10 dominant MCQ stems; stem entropy is 1.15 bits.
template_collapse.impact: Suppresses non-MCQ formatting and causes question-type accuracy failure (46.80%).

control_blindness.impact: Altering difficulty (Easy/Hard), marks (1/5), or question type yields identical generated output.

numerical_reasoning_failure.impact: Generates MCQ text stems without numbers/calculations for numerical prompts.

training_memorization_breach.impact: Model copies verbatim training sequences for high-frequency topics.

subject_topic_mismatch.impact: Generic template stems omit specific domain entities required for 100% topic accuracy.

cross_metric_root_causes.primary_root_cause: MCQ Template Collapse & Loss of Control-Token Conditioning
cross_metric_root_causes.mechanism: The fine-tuned FLAN-T5-small model learned language fluency (98.20% validity) and class tokens (81.60% groundedness), but collapsed onto high-frequency MCQ target priors during 3-epoch training. The model ignores input control tags (0.00% control sensitivity) and defaults to MCQ stems regardless of requested question type or difficulty.

distinction.observed_evidence: 100% top-10 concentration, 0% control sensitivity, 46.80% type accuracy, 19.41% numerical validity.
distinction.likely_root_cause: High proportion of MCQ targets in training supervision data combined with insufficient control-token loss weighting.
distinction.unverified_hypothesis: Scaling to 250M FLAN-T5-base or applying explicit control-token penalty loss will restore control sensitivity.

improvements: Class groundedness increased to 81.60% (V16) from UNKNOWN token dominance in V15.

final_step12_conclusion: Step 12 forensic audit complete. Empirical evidence demonstrates that V16 achieved marked improvements in topic grounding (+29.33%) and class differentiation (+81.60%), but suffered from critical MCQ template collapse (100% top-10 concentration) and total control blindness (0.00% sensitivity).
